title: Cell indices precede input indices
statement: Let $M$ be a finite-state Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, let $N,T$ be natural numbers, and write $k$ for the number of states of $M$. Define the stride $s=k(2T+1)+N+3$. For every time $t$, state index $	au$ with $0\leq\tau<k$, row index $r<2T+1$, and natural number $p$, the index $ts+\tau(2T+1)+r$ is strictly less than $ts+k(2T+1)+p$.
